# PLAN.md — Clinician Web Dashboard (Patient Data + Live PPG Streaming)

**Generated by:** Claude (Research & Theoretical Architect)
**Date:** 2026-09-03
**For:** Antigravity (Software Engineer Architect) — implement against the stack
contract already agreed in `ANTIGRAVITY.md` §4.5, ADR-001, and
`06 - Antigravity Notes/2026-09-03 - Dual-Agent System Architecture & Engineering Blueprint.md`,
**except** the directory location: the website goes in `07 - Website/`, not
`03 - ML/dashboard/` (see below — this supersedes `ANTIGRAVITY.md` §6 on that point).
**Research basis:** `05 - Claude Notes/2026-09-03 - Website Tier Requirements & Firmware Gap Analysis.md`

## Context

User wants the clinician-facing website built now: patient data management + a live
PPG streaming session view. Inspected the Pi directly (SSH over Tailscale,
`raspberrypi` @ `100.77.17.38`) and found one blocking gap before the dashboard's live
view can show anything real.

**Folder placement (user directive, 2026-09-03):** the website (frontend + backend)
must live in its own top-level folder, **`07 - Website/`** — not under `03 - ML/`.
`03 - ML/` is the edge ML/DSP/firmware codebase (Python + C++, runs on the Pi/ESP32);
the website is a separate Node.js + HTML/CSS/JS codebase with its own runtime and
deploy lifecycle. Do not create a `dashboard/` folder inside `03 - ML/`. Structure:

```
07 - Website/
├── backend/     # Node.js (Express recommended) API + WebSocket relay + auth
└── frontend/    # HTML5/CSS3/JS client: patient CRUD UI, login, live PPG view
```

The backend still reads/writes the *same* shared SQLite file that `03 - ML/storage/`
owns (per ADR-001's WAL-mode split: Python owns `arrhythmia_events`, Node.js owns
`patients`) — separating the codebases does not separate the database.

## 0. BLOCKING — firmware emits a derived scalar, not raw PPG

`~/MyEspProject/MyEspProject.ino` on the Pi (ESP32-C3 + MAX30102) samples at 200 Hz but
only Serial-prints a heuristic BPM string every 500 ms from an on-device threshold peak
detector — it never sends raw IR/red samples off the chip. Per Thesis Ch.2, the 1D-CNN
takes the raw segmented waveform (not hand-engineered features), and Grad-CAM must
localize regions within that raw waveform. Neither the classification pipeline nor a
live waveform view has anything to work with until this is fixed.

- [x] Extend the firmware to emit fixed-rate raw sample frames (IR + red + monotonic
      timestamp) over serial, using the framed protocol already decided in ADR-001
      (`0xAA`/`0x55` delimiters + CRC16), at the 100 Hz rate specified in
      `ANTIGRAVITY.md` §4.1.
- [x] Keep the existing on-device heuristic BPM/OLED alert path as-is — it's a useful
      local fallback independent of the Pi link and should not be removed.
- [x] Move the firmware source to `03 - ML/firmware/src/main.cpp` per the directory
      contract in `ANTIGRAVITY.md` §6 while making this change.

## 6. Visual Design System — Restyle Pass (remove AI-slop execution)

**Context:** the current `07 - Website/frontend/` UI is functionally correct (verified:
32/32 tests pass, live streaming/Grad-CAM overlay/auth/CRUD all work) but its visual
execution reads as generic AI-generated dashboard boilerplate: cyan/blue gradients on
every button and the brand logo, emoji standing in for icons throughout (🫀📈👥📜⚡📡🔬),
neon glow box-shadows, and `border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-cyan)` accent cards.
This is a **restyle pass only** — do not change HTML structure, IDs, classes used by
JS, or any functionality/data flow. Only `css/styles.css`, the icon markup (replace
inline emoji with inline SVG), and font `<link>` tags in `index.html`'s `<head>` change.

**Direction (settled with user): Light Clinical.** Trustworthy, calm, primary-care
software — not a SOC/NOC monitoring aesthetic.

- **Palette (flat colors, no gradients anywhere):**
  - Background: `#FAF9F6` (warm off-white)
  - Surface/card: `#FFFFFF`, hairline border `#E4E1DA`
  - Text primary: `#201F1D`; text secondary/muted: `#6B6862`
  - Primary accent (nav, primary buttons, focus rings): `#0E6B76` (deep teal)
  - Alert / AF-positive: `#C13B3B` (muted clinical red — not neon `#EF4444`)
  - Success / NSR: `#3F7D5C` (muted sage green — not neon `#10B981`)
  - Warning / local-only sync: `#B5792B` (muted amber — not neon `#F59E0B`)
  - Drop `--accent-purple` entirely; reduce the palette to exactly these tokens plus
    neutrals. No per-element one-off colors outside these CSS custom properties.
- **Typography:** headings in **Newsreader** (serif, Google Fonts), body/UI text in
  **Public Sans** (Google Fonts) — both loaded via a `<link>` in `<head>` per the CSP
  rule (fonts.googleapis.com/fonts.gstatic.com only). Keep the existing monospace stack
  for hashes/timestamps — that one is fine as-is. Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Arial.
- **Icons:** replace every emoji glyph with a hand-authored inline SVG (stroke-based,
  `currentColor`, consistent 20–24px grid, Feather/Lucide-style) — no emoji anywhere in
  the UI. Mapping: 🫀 brand mark → a simple heartbeat/ECG-line mark (not a literal
  heart); 📈 → waveform/activity icon; 👥 → people icon; 📜 → list/ledger icon; ⚡ →
  gauge icon; 📡 → signal/broadcast icon; 🔬 → a scan/layers icon (not a literal
  microscope); 👤 → single-user icon; ⏱️ → clock icon; 🛡️ → shield-check icon; 🔗/💾 →
  either a small link/disk icon or drop the icon and rely on the existing text badge.
- **Remove these specific patterns:** every `linear-gradient(...)` on buttons/logo/
  headers (flat fills instead); every glow-style `box-shadow` using `rgba(...)` color
  blur on buttons, badges, or the AF alert pulse animation (use the alert's color and
  weight, not a blur radius, to signal urgency); the `border-left: 3px solid` accent
  pattern on `.patient-info-summary` and anywhere else it appears (use spacing/
  typography hierarchy instead); the `radial-gradient` login background (flat warm
  off-white instead).
- **Keep:** all existing copy (it's real, specific thesis content — Caloocan barangay
  names, ADR-001 references, the ISO/IEC 25010 matrix — not filler), all HTML
  structure/IDs/classes referenced by the JS files, the card/table/modal layout
  patterns (just restyled with the new tokens), the Grad-CAM heat-strip color legend
  (recolor its low/mid/high swatches to fit the new palette, but keep it a 3-step
  heat legend).
- [x] Apply the above restyle to `07 - Website/frontend/css/styles.css`.
- [x] Replace emoji with inline SVG icons per the mapping above, across `index.html`
      and any JS that injects emoji into dynamically-rendered rows (`patients.js`,
      `history.js`, `live-stream.js`, `telemetry.js` — check each for emoji strings).
- [x] Add the Google Fonts `<link>` for Newsreader + Public Sans to `index.html`.
- [x] Re-run `npm test` after the restyle to confirm no functional regression (the

## 7. Real Serial Ingestion + Boot-Time Automation (Pi deployment)

**Context:** deployed and running live on the Pi (`/home/ranilo/Arrhythmia Thesis/`,
Tailscale IP `100.77.17.38`). User wants the whole pipeline to start automatically on
Pi boot, and for the website to capture real signal once the ESP32-C3 is connected —
not just the synthetic demo. Two real gaps found:

1. **`03 - ML/edge_inference/runner.py` never reads real serial data.** It imports
   `StreamPacketParser`/`pack_ppg_frame` from `serial_protocol.py` but only ever calls
   `run_simulation()` — there is no code path that opens a serial port and feeds real
   frames into `ingest_sample()`. Worse, the `--simulate` CLI flag is defined as
   `action="store_true", default=True`, which means it is **always `True`** regardless
   of whether the flag is passed — there is currently no way to run this script in a
   non-simulated mode at all.
2. **No ESP32 is currently connected to the Pi via USB** (`ls /dev/ttyUSB* /dev/ttyACM*`
   found nothing at the time of this check) — expected, since it's normally used
   standalone, but the runner needs to tolerate the device not being present at boot
   and pick it up whenever it's plugged in, rather than requiring it up front.

The website side needs **no changes** for this — `07 - Website/backend`'s TCP
bridge/WebSocket relay already carries whatever `runner.py` publishes (this is exactly
how the synthetic demo already streams to the browser today); once `runner.py` is
reading a real device, the exact same pipeline carries real data through.

- [x] Fix `runner.py`'s argument parsing: default to **real serial mode**; make
      `--simulate` an explicit opt-in fallback (for bench-testing without hardware),
      not the only mode.
- [x] Implement real serial ingestion: auto-detect the ESP32 (`/dev/ttyUSB*` or
      `/dev/ttyACM*`, override via `--port`) via `pyserial` (already installed on the
      Pi) at 115200 baud (matches `Serial.begin(115200)` in `main.cpp`), feed incoming
      bytes into the existing `StreamPacketParser`, and call `ingest_sample(ts_ms,
      ir_raw, red_raw)` for each successfully parsed frame — the parser and packet
      format already match the firmware exactly, this is purely wiring.
- [x] If no matching serial device is found (or it disconnects), poll/retry (e.g. every
      2s) and log a clear waiting message — do not crash or exit. The Pi may boot
      before the ESP32 is plugged in, or the board may reset.
- [x] Add two systemd unit files (Debian/systemd confirmed on this Pi — Debian 13
      "trixie") so both processes start automatically on every boot:
      - `arrhythmia-website.service` — `ExecStart=/usr/bin/node src/server.js` with
        `WorkingDirectory=/home/ranilo/Arrhythmia Thesis/07 - Website/backend`,
        `Restart=on-failure`, `WantedBy=multi-user.target`.
      - `arrhythmia-edge.service` — `ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 edge_inference/runner.py`
        with `WorkingDirectory=/home/ranilo/Arrhythmia Thesis/03 - ML`,
        `After=arrhythmia-website.service`, `Restart=on-failure`,
        `RestartSec=3`, `WantedBy=multi-user.target`.
      Install both to `/etc/systemd/system/`, then `systemctl daemon-reload` and
      `systemctl enable --now arrhythmia-website arrhythmia-edge`.
- [ ] Verify after enabling: `sudo reboot` the Pi (or `systemctl restart` both units),
      confirm `systemctl status` shows both active, `curl localhost:8080/api/health`
      responds, and — if an ESP32 is plugged in — real BPM/waveform data (not the
      synthetic demo pattern) appears in the live view within a few seconds.

## 8. Model Training — from untrained scaffold to trained, externally-validated weights

**Context:** the 1D-CNN in `03 - ML/model/inference_model.py` has never been trained — its
weights are He-init random, and `_calibrate_weights()` only nudges the output bias. This is
the top open blocker in `MEMORY.md`. Full prompt-by-prompt brief, with the locked
architectural decisions and their rationale, lives in
[[05 - Claude Notes/2026-09-13 - ML Training Prompt Pack for Antigravity|2026-09-13 - ML Training Prompt Pack for Antigravity]].
Execute in order; §8.3, §8.7 and §8.8 are gates that must pass before continuing.

**Locked decisions:** **DeepBeat trains and MIMIC PERform AF externally validates** — a
reversal of the first draft, decided 2026-09-13 on accuracy grounds (wrist reflectance
matches the MAX30102 deployment, ~500k windows vs ~4.2k against a 1.03M-parameter model,
and per-window rather than per-recording labels). Training happens in PyTorch on a dev
machine while the Pi keeps the pure-NumPy runtime. The Chapter 2 topology is frozen and
regularization is training-time only. Splits are subject-isolated, never by window. All
datasets are resampled to 100 Hz and re-windowed to 1000 samples before touching the
model. Training preprocessing imports `signal_processing/` rather than reimplementing it.
The decision threshold is a calibrated artifact stored in the weights metadata, not a
hardcoded `0.50`.

**Longest-lead item: DeepBeat requires Stanford registration/licence approval. Start that
request first.** MIMIC PERform AF is openly available and is not needed until §8.6.

## 10. Carried over from the superseded post-bring-up plan

§8 absorbed the honesty guards and the training handoff. These three items were in the
2026-09-10 post-bring-up plan, were **not** covered by §8, and are still open.

- [ ] **Calibrate the SQI gate against ground truth.** `MIN_SQI_SCORE = 0.7` and
      `CONTACT_IR_THRESHOLD = 50000` were both picked by eye during bring-up. DeepBeat's
      `qa_label` is a 3-class human-labelled signal-quality ground truth over the same
      signal type — use it to choose defensible values and report the sensitivity and
      specificity of the gate itself. Record the result as an ADR.
- [ ] **Data cleanup** (order matters, or the edge service will not start): create a real
      patient through the dashboard, repoint `TARGET_PATIENT_ID` in
      `/home/ranilo/.config/arrhythmia/edge.env` at it, and only then purge the 3 seeded
      patients, the bring-up noise events, **and the two compromised `users` rows** —
      `03 - ML/scripts/purge_synthetic_data.py` does not currently touch `users`. The
      SHA-256 chain cannot be patched after deletion; reinitialise from genesis and
      re-verify via `/api/events/verify/chain`. Surface the exact commands for review
      before running anything against the live database.
- [ ] **Correct `ANTIGRAVITY.md` §5.** The Performance Efficiency row still claims
      "inference ~13.08 ms", measured on synthetic data. The real re-benchmarked figure is
      **16.39 ms mean / 18.43 ms p95** over 100 windows, inside the 25 ms budget. Update
      the Functional Suitability row too — it can now cite measured numbers, but must cite
      the external MIMIC and cross-validated bounds alongside the internal sensitivity.
